verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe DeepInfra as a drop-in OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint. The only changes needed are base_url, api_key and the model name, so an agent can move to or from it without provider-specific code. Requests are stateless and carry the full message history each time, which supports switching mid-workflow. DeepInfra-specific parameters such as service_tier and fail_fast are optional. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of drop-in compatibility, and documentation of parity for tool calling and streaming edge cases.
